notes: Six routes (each «ح» or new «وحدثنا» begins one), closed by «كلهم عن نافع، عن ابن عمر» after the last «ح» (shared tail, rule 3).
«كلاهما عن أيوب» closes the Ismail route at Ayyub. Read as that route's level only; the text does not write Ayyub after Hammad, so the first route ends at Hammad.
«في الضب بمعنى حديث الليث عن نافع» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route. «نافع» there is occurrence 2.
«غير أن حديث أيوب» and «وفي حديث أسامة قال قام رجل» are wording or scene remarks: left out. «أبي» (Ibn Numayr's father) is relation.
